		FROM episode_catalog_entries ece JOIN episodes sort_episode ON sort_episode.content_id = ece.episode_id JOIN media_items sort_series ON sort_series.content_id = ece.series_id
		WHERE ece.media_folder_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($2)) AND (ece.content_rating_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.content_rating_age <= $3) AND (ece.advisory_age IS NOT NULL AND ece.advisory_age <= $4) AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM media_items si
		WHERE si.content_id = ece.series_id
		  AND si.type = 'series'
	) AND ece.sort_key LIKE $5 ESCAPE '\'
		ORDER BY ece.episode_air_date ASC NULLS LAST, LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(sort_series.sort_title), ''), sort_series.title)) ASC, ece.series_id ASC, sort_episode.season_number ASC, sort_episode.episode_number ASC, ece.episode_id ASC
		LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7

user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2

				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)

WITH user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)
SELECT ece.episode_id, ece.added_at
		FROM user_viewed uv JOIN episode_catalog_entries ece ON ece.episode_id = uv.episode_id
		WHERE ece.media_folder_id = $3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM media_items si
		WHERE si.content_id = ece.series_id
		  AND si.type = 'series'
	)
		ORDER BY uv.last_watched ASC NULLS LAST, ece.sort_key ASC, ece.episode_id ASC
		LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6

					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),

			FROM (

			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)

		WHERE si.content_id = ece.series_id

user_state.page_sql:
WITH user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)

		LIMIT $7

WITH user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)

user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)

		WHERE ece.media_folder_id = $3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_item_libraries mil WHERE mil.content_id = ece.series_id AND mil.media_folder_id = ANY($4)) AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1
		FROM media_items si
		WHERE si.content_id = ece.series_id
		  AND si.type = 'series'
	) AND uv.episode_id IS NULL
		ORDER BY ece.added_at DESC, ece.sort_key ASC, ece.episode_id ASC
		LIMIT $5
user_state.seek_sql:
WITH user_viewed AS (
			SELECT src.episode_id,
				MAX(src.last_watched) AS last_watched,
				NULLIF(GREATEST(
					COALESCE(MAX(src.history_play_count), 0),
					COALESCE(MAX(src.progress_play_count), 0)
				), 0) AS play_count
			FROM (
				SELECT uwh.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					MAX(uwh.watched_at) AS last_watched,
					COUNT(*)::integer AS history_play_count,
					NULL::integer AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_history uwh
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwh.media_item_id
				WHERE uwh.user_id = $1
				  AND uwh.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwh.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwh.watched_at > hhi.hidden_before)
				GROUP BY uwh.media_item_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT uwp.media_item_id AS episode_id,
					uwp.updated_at AS last_watched,
					NULL::integer AS history_play_count,
					1 AS progress_play_count
				FROM user_watch_progress uwp
				LEFT JOIN user_history_hidden_items hhi
					ON hhi.user_id = $1
				   AND hhi.profile_id = $2
				   AND hhi.media_item_id = uwp.media_item_id
				WHERE uwp.user_id = $1
				  AND uwp.profile_id = $2
				  AND uwp.completed = TRUE
				  AND (hhi.media_item_id IS NULL OR uwp.updated_at > hhi.hidden_before)
			) src
			GROUP BY src.episode_id
		)
